title: Plural genitive of -nen words: -sten/-sien
focus: Replace -nen with -sten or -sien in these words: nainen (“woman”) → naisten.

exercises.prompt: Choose the plural genitive of nainen (“woman”).
exercises.explanation: Replace -nen with -sten or -sien: naisten or naisien. These standard forms are all accepted: naisten, naisien.

optionFeedback.naisten: Replace -nen with -sten or -sien: naisten or naisien. These standard forms are all accepted: naisten, naisien.
optionFeedback.nainen: nainen is the dictionary form; this question needs the plural genitive.
optionFeedback.nainenn: nainenn does not use the plural genitive stem and ending for nainen.
